Subject: Rapid MQL triage & demo booking: Scaling GenAI in Retail webinar

Team — exporting the full attendee list from this morning's "Scaling GenAI in Retail" webinar and a quick prioritization suggestion. See attachments: attendee_export_20270630.csv (full export) and mutual_action_plan_v1.docx (template).

Quick asks:
- Marcus / Neha: Can you triage the CSV and mark the top 40 MQLs by 3pm PT? Prioritization guidance is in mql_prioritization_criteria.md (attached).
- Grace: can you own EMEA accounts from the list and flag any timezone constraints?
- Sales ops: please make sure HubSpot status + lead owner are updated for the top 40. I left the initial score column from the webinar platform but please re-score per the attached criteria.

Priority for demo booking: focus demo outreach on companies with >$20M ARR or clear platform-fit signals (mentions of personalization, recommendations, search). If an attendee is C-suite + engaged, push for an executive briefing slot; otherwise standard 30m demo.

I've already pre-marked 12 accounts I recommend for immediate outreach in column "redwood_reco" in the CSV. Marcus — if you can seed the first 10 invites this afternoon, we can get commitments for next week.

Thanks — Vanessa

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Vanessa — thanks for the export and notes. A couple of quick clarifications before I start triage:
1) For the "engaged" filter, are we using webinar Q&A + poll responses or the platform engagement score? I'll default to engagement score + poll 'asked question' flag if you don't mind.
2) Demo availability: do we want to prioritize mornings PT for US accounts (8–11am PT) or do the SDRs have more success later?

Plan: Neha and I will split the export (US + Americas) and run the scoring pass. If we hit 40 by 3pm PT we'll publish the list to the shared Drive and update HubSpot with owners.
